source_refs.note: Topic 5.5.1.4 Scatterplots (PDF 147-148, printed 144-145). Figure 5.7 is described in the text; the original diagram uses the class activity's data.

blocks.text: Scatterplots show the relationship between two variables: each point is one observation, placed by its two values. A scatterplot can be used to explore the relationship between hours studied and exam scores.
